answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the meadow binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 7 separate vaults needs a separate funded tide account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The prism explorer shows the whole merge tree. A 96 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
